title: Caltech transfer fails improvement gates; original numerical audit failure localized
summary: All fixed comparisons completed. Candidate source settings score 98.032%/97.978667% versus augmented-support ridge98.330667% and C10 logistic98.392%. Both fail improvement and DTD-gallery guardrails. Original independent audit failed; bounded 240-check diagnosis finds one shared score-ensemble top64 precision discrepancy (two source copies), no sampled prediction changes, all72 paired intervals match. Other sampled ridge methods pass. No full-audit-pass, novel-method or broad-generalization claim.
comparability: New-domain auxiliary transfer; canonical five Pets metrics unchanged; both fixed source configurations/all ten methods retained, original R2 has lower view budget. Conditional task intervals from fixed pools; same tasks shared by source configurations.
takeaway: Do not promote the cumulative stack as a robust improvement. Negative candidate-versus-support-only ridge evidence does not rely on the numerically discrepant ensemble control.
